description: Gets canonical metadata for one Google Calendar, defaulting to the authenticated user's primary calendar. Returns its identifier, title, description, location, time zone, and conference properties. Use googlecalendar.calendar_list_get for one calendar's user-specific list settings such as access role, color, visibility, selection, and default reminders; use googlecalendar.list_calendars to enumerate accessible calendars.

calendar_id.description: Identifier of the Google Calendar to retrieve. Must be 'primary' (the default) for the user's main calendar, or an email-like identifier (e.g., 'user@example.com' or 'en.usa#holiday@group.v.calendar.google.com'). IMPORTANT: Calendar display names/titles (e.g., 'Work', 'Vacation') are NOT valid identifiers and will result in errors. To find a calendar's ID, use the LIST_CALENDARS action which returns the 'id' field for each calendar.
calendar_id.human_parameter_description: Which calendar you want to retrieve. Use 'primary' for your main calendar, or use the calendar's email-like identifier for a shared or secondary calendar. IMPORTANT: Calendar display names (like 'Work' or 'Vacation') are NOT valid - you must use 'primary' or the calendar's email address. If you only know the calendar's name, use the List Calendars action to find its ID.
calendar_id.title: Calendar Id

name: get_calendar

conferenceProperties.description: Conferencing properties for this calendar. Read-only.
conferenceProperties.title: Conference Properties

etag.description: ETag of the resource. Used for caching and concurrency control. Read-only.
etag.title: Etag

id.description: Identifier of the calendar, typically an email-like value (e.g., the calendar's primary email address). Read-only.
id.title: Id

kind.description: Type of the resource. Always 'calendar#calendar'. Read-only.
kind.title: Kind

location.description: Geographic location of the calendar as free-form text. Optional.
location.title: Location

summary.description: Title or display name of the calendar.
summary.title: Summary

timeZone.description: The time zone of the calendar, specified as an IANA Time Zone Database name (e.g., 'Europe/Zurich', 'America/Denver', 'Asia/Kolkata'). Optional.
timeZone.title: Time Zone

allowedConferenceSolutionTypes.description: The types of conference solutions supported for this calendar. Read-only. Possible values include: 'eventHangout', 'eventNamedHangout', 'hangoutsMeet'.
allowedConferenceSolutionTypes.title: Allowed Conference Solution Types

calendar_data.description: Calendar resource data as returned by the Google Calendar API. This object includes fields such as kind, etag, id, summary, description, location, timeZone, and conferenceProperties.
calendar_data.title: Calendar Data

display_url.description: Direct URL to view this calendar's settings in the Google Calendar web interface.
display_url.title: Display Url
